captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a hollow spherical shell segment with large circular cutouts on its curved surfaces, resulting in two separate curved, thin-walled bands facing each other. The bands have a uniform thickness and smooth, faceted curvature along their edges. The top and bottom sections are completely open, and the side openings are circular, leaving behind a delicate, open-frame spherical structure.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hollow sphere template in OpenSCAD that allows customization of wall thickness and level of detail. It should include options to select different MakerBot Replicator build volumes to auto-crop the design, as well as a cross-section option to cut the final model along any of the six major half-axes using an offset eraser cube.
captions.factory: The code defines a hollow sphere by subtracting a smaller sphere from a larger one, with the radius based on a selected MakerBot build volume and the wall thickness defined by a variable. This hollow sphere is intersected with a bounding cube representing the selected build chamber size. Finally, a conditional difference operation is used: if a cross-section is selected, a large offset cube is subtracted from the model to slice it in half along the chosen axis.
